**Requesting details for clarity**

I think I should consider asking for specific details to better understand the user's needs. It might be helpful to provide a template that includes placeholders for those details, along with some concise tips to guide them. This way, they could easily fill it out, and I could gather all the necessary information efficiently! Keeping it straightforward is key to ensuring I can assist them effectively.
[/Thinking]

Subject: Proposal for Joint Venture Collaboration – [Your Company] & [Their Company]

Dear [Mr./Ms./Dr. Last Name] [Last Name],

I hope you are doing well. My name is [Your Name], and I am [Title] at [Your Company]. I’m reaching out to explore the possibility of a joint venture between [Your Company] and [Their Company] to [briefly state shared objective/opportunity, e.g., “develop and bring to market a new line of…” / “expand into the [region] market”].

Based on our understanding of [Their Company]’s strengths in [capability/asset—e.g., distribution network, technical expertise, market presence] and [Your Company]’s strengths in [capability/asset—e.g., product development, manufacturing, customer base], we believe a structured partnership could create meaningful value for both organizations.

**Proposed concept (initial outline):**
- **Scope:** [What the JV would do—products/services/market]
- **Target market/customers:** [Who you would serve]
- **Contributions:**  
  - [Your Company]: [capital/resources/IP/team/operations]  
  - [Their Company]: [capital/resources/IP/team/operations]
- **Value proposition:** [Expected benefits—revenue growth, cost efficiencies, faster market entry]
- **Potential structure:** [e.g., 50/50 JV, majority/minority, contractual JV—if you have a preference]
- **Timeline:** [e.g., feasibility discussion in 2–3 weeks; draft term sheet by (date)]

If you are open to it, I would appreciate the opportunity to schedule a [30–45]-minute call to discuss strategic fit, objectives, and next steps. Please let me know your availability during the week of [date range], or feel free to suggest a time that works best for you.

I can also share a brief overview deck and a high-level business case in advance, if helpful.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the possibility of collaborating.

Sincerely,  
[Your Full Name]  
[Title] | [Your Company]  
[Phone] | [Email] | [Website]  
[LinkedIn, optional]  

---

If you share a few details (industry, what each side brings, target market, and your preferred JV structure), I can tailor this into a more specific, ready-to-send email with stronger language and the right level of formality.
